integrity: Analytical proof supplied; executable finite diagnostics are not offered as infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: Only stationary single-time squared displacement under deterministic multiplicative rescaling, for \(D,r>0\) and \(|a|<1\).
Convex order is for displacement squared after variance normalization, not unnormalized tails or first-passage laws.
The Gaussian lower endpoint is approached as \(a^2\) tends to one and is not attained within the admissible model.
The uniform small-\(1-a^2\) correction is proved on compact subsets of strictly positive thresholds.
Classical majorization and previously published stationary distribution are explicitly credited; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp squared-displacement risk ordering and Gaussianization under multiplicative Brownian resetting
